pages.text: You kept wondering why there was no servant that was purely a mount - one that does not fight and does not attack, but exists to be ridden.$(br)After some time spent researching, you succeeded in converting a Skeleton Horse into a servant of your own.

There is nothing to tell it apart from a vanilla Skeleton Horse, except that it can now wear horse armour and can be called quickly with a focus.$(br)You can feed your Skeleton Horse Servant bones to heal it.$(br)Health 20 / Attack 4 / Speed 0.3 / Follow Range 24.$(br)No saddle needed: right-click it empty-handed to mount and steer with ; sneak + empty hand takes the horse armour back; the armour drops on death.
The armour adds its own armor points.$(br)Servants can ride it too: select a servant with the command focus, then right-click this horse.
